name: JunkieRehabilitation
description:
Adds a new drug which allows to rehabilitate defeated Drug Den junkies into cellblock inmates, in case you wish to meet them again.

The pill can sometimes be found as loot. Alternatively, you can purchase it for 100 credits from the Med Lobby's vendomat.

[color=#E1FFCC]<update highlights>[/color]
v0.4.0
- Some of the rescued inmates might have names you've not seen before! These were handpicked by me, so there should be many charming names and nicknames. At the same time, I cannot be trusted naming creatures~
- The pills now have side effects which may cause slight changes to personality or fetish interests. While adverse on the first two floors, they somehow tend to turn quite beneficial once one progresses just a little further into the den..
- Added quick access to consumable items when approaching encounters. It's not that I'm trying to compete with the rescued critters for the amount of delivered comfort..
[color=#E1FFCC]</>[/color]

Compatibility
`/Modules/DrugDenModule/DrugDen/DrugDenEncounterTemplateScene.gd` is overridden to allow all of this to happen.

`DrugDenEncounterBossScene.gd`, `DrugDenEncounterFirstScene.gd`, `DrugDenEncounterInstantFightScene.gd`, `DrugDenEventWhoreScene.gd` and `DrugDenEventWhoreSubScene.gd` are overridden to modify path to the class they inherit. No other lines were changed besides line 44 in the boss scene.
